verdict.rationale: Simular documents one recovery mechanism. Saved workflow code "heals itself": when a replayed step breaks because the UI changed, the agent takes over from that point, and replays consult the model where the screen matters. That covers some state-drift recovery for replayed skills. Missing for 10: documented retry semantics (counts, backoff, failure modes), explicit popup/dialog handling, recovery from failed actions during live (non-replay) runs, guarantees against wedging or timeouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
